summary: 57-year-old Kathleen Ann Leber reported missing from Woodland Park the prior evening; Colorado State Patrol found her vehicle crashed through a wire fence into a tree near South Hwy 67 MM89 by Rainbow Falls; DCSO and Douglas County SAR searched the crash-site area and located her deceased nearby, converting the search into a death investigation with no apparent suspicious circumstances
location: South Hwy 67 MM89 near Rainbow Falls, Woodland Park area
responding_agency: Teller County Sheriff's Office (lead agency); Douglas County Sheriff's Office and Douglas County SAR (agency assist); Colorado State Patrol
notes: DCSO newsroom releases (both opened run 540). DCSO/DCSAR deployment was an agency assist to the Teller County Sheriff's Office, so county is Teller. Reported missing evening of 2014-11-16; vehicle found by CSP; deceased adult female found during the SAR search of the crash-site area; coroner to confirm identity/cause.
